description: Guyana value-added tax (VAT) for 2026 under the Value-Added Tax Act, Cap. 81:05 (Act No. 10 of 2005) and the Value-Added Tax Regulations 2005, as amended to 2026 including the Fiscal Enactments (Amendment) Act 2026 (Act No. 3 of 2026). Covers the 14% rate, the G$15,000,000 registration threshold and the 15-day deadline to apply, voluntary registration, zero-rated and exempt supplies and the February 2026 changes (locally produced furniture and jewellery, ATVs, fire and security equipment zero-rated; small double cabs, new small cars, hybrids and outboard engines exempt), VAT on imported goods and the self-charge on imported services, input tax credit and the blocked items, partial exemption and the 90% rule, monthly returns (G0002, G0001) due on the 21st, refunds, interest and penalties. Trigger on: Guyana VAT 2026, GRA VAT return, VAT registration Guyana, 14% VAT, zero-rated Guyana, imported services VAT, VATIS, G0002. Out of scope: excise tax, customs duty, income and corporation tax
